title: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 is vulnerable to improper TLS certificate validation in the GDP Terraform provider,…
description: IBM Guardium Data Protection 12.2 contains a vulnerability in its GDP Terraform provider related to improper TLS certificate validation. This flaw allows a network attacker positioned for man-in-the-middle attacks to intercept sensitive credentials sent to the Guardium appliance. The vulnerability has a high severity rating with a CVSS score of 8.1.
